subject: Request: Demo Credit Waiver & Billing Path for Bridge Labs Pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@bridgelabs.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo credit waiver request for Bridge Labs pilot

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Bridge Labs team is excited about trying Redwood for our image-to-text pipelines. We ran a quick internal budget check and our incubator grant will not cover the initial usage spike during the pilot.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide a one-time demo credit waiver (we're asking for $5k of free credits for the first 30 days) so we can validate throughput without impacting our grant budget?
- If a waiver is possible, can billing be routed to our sponsor (Bridge Labs Finance) for the onboarding fee only (no immediate card on file for consumption during the pilot)?

We have an SOW draft attached (BridgeLabs_SOW_v2.pdf) and a short usage export for the past month (bridge-usage-summary-jul2027.csv). If helpful, we can jump on a 20-min call to walk through expected token patterns.

Appreciate any flexibility — the team is aiming to convert to a paid Dedicated contract if the pilot clears performance.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Platform — Bridge Labs
A: aisha@bridgelabs.ai
T: +1 415-555-0192

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@bridgelabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo credit waiver request for Bridge Labs pilot

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and for sharing the SOW.

Short answer: we can usually make a one-time demo credit exception for verified incubator pilots, but we need to align on two items before I can commit:
1) Scope & success criteria in the SOW (brief bullet list) so we can tie any conversion credit to milestones.
2) Billing routing for the $1k onboarding fee and any overage guardrails.

Ben, Irene — looping you both in for approval on the waiver and billing path. Bridge Labs is requesting $5k in demo credits for 30 days; they propose the sponsor covers a $1k onboarding fee separately. The SOW is attached — please review the milestone language in section 2.

Aisha — can you confirm the milestone bullets (deploy LLM to staging, achieve <150ms median p99 for eval harness, and produce an ROI memo within 30 days)? If yes, I'll draft the internal approval note and proposed credit carveout.

Thanks,
Sofia
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
--
attachments: BridgeLabs_SOW_v2.pdf, bridge-usage-summary-jul2027.csv

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: approval path for Bridge Labs demo credit waiver (DL-2027-0198)

Team —

Summarizing Bridge Labs request and my recommended approach so we can move quickly:
- Request: $5k one-time demo credit for 30 days tied to pilot milestones (staging deployment + perf target + ROI memo).
- Customer asks that onboarding fee ($1k) be billed to their sponsor (Bridge Labs Finance) rather than charge their card upfront. They will not supply a card for pilot consumption.

Risks/notes:
- No card on file increases exposure to overages if they exceed credits; recommend strict consumption cap and auto-suspend beyond credits.
- Accounting: promo credit needs a tracking line; legal wants the SOW language to say "pilot credits are non-transferable, expire 30 days after activation."

My proposal:
- Approve $5k demo credit for 30 days contingent on SOW milestone acceptance.
- Approve sponsor-billed $1k onboarding invoice (AP/PO to finance@bridgelabs.ai) — finance team to send PO and we route invoice to marketplace billing.
- Configure consumption cap at $5,000 and an auto-suspend at 95% of credit to alert both teams.

Requests:
- Ben: confirm discount/credit approval (I suggest we treat this as "pilot promo" not a discount to TCV so it doesn't affect forecasting).
- Irene: confirm ops on the invoice routing flow and that billing team can accept sponsor PO without card-on-file.

If both OK, I'll reply to Aisha with the approval language and attach the adjusted SOW clause.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: approval path for Bridge Labs demo credit waiver (DL-2027-0198)

+1 from me. Approve $5k pilot credit (pilot promo) and sponsor-billed $1k onboarding invoice. Keep as promo/credit (not discount) and cap auto-suspend at 95% as suggested.

Please:
- Sofia, ask legal to sign off on the SOW clause (short exception wording).
- Irene, once you confirm billing flow, we can issue the credit and send the onboarding invoice to Bridge Labs Finance (finance@bridgelabs.ai).

Thanks — Ben
Head of GTM | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
